method: Independent static original MIPS call-chain verification

evidence.detail: LUI gp,0x8008; ADDIU gp,gp,0x2AC8 initializes GP.
LW a1,0x2C4(gp) loads GR.VFS filename pointer; JAL 0x80052200 passes filename and destination mount-header structure.
Sets read-system flag 0x20 before JAL 0x80036168 with filename, byte offset 0 and length16; reads original VFS header by filename.
Validates VFS magic0x30534656 from freshly read16-byte header.
JAL 0x80033EE8 converts read-system current file MSF at0x80085754 into LBA.
Computes TOC base as current file LBA+1 and stores it in mount-header+4.
Computes VFS data base as current file LBA+header.u32@8 and stores it in mount-header+8.
Initializes file lookup callback0x80085760 to0x80034AE4, not a fixed GR.VFS extent.
File read resolves filename in request+0x27 through callback0x80085760 and retains returned location/size.
When flag0x20 is set, lookup wrapper0x80036FA4 forces direct filename lookup0x80034AE4 rather than archive cache.
Filename lookup normalizes path, appends;1 and calls ISO filesystem search0x80034E14.
ISO filesystem search traverses directories and compares filenames; diagnostics identify DsSearchFile.
On filename match, copies current directory result location/size into destination structure.
TOC read uses computed LBA from mount-header+4; per-member CD positions are generated from member-relative offset+computed data base at0x80052360..6C.

conclusion: The inspected disc VFS initialization and member-read path derives its absolute sectors from ISO filename lookup. Relocating GR.VFS requires updating its ISO9660 directory extent and byte size, preserving relative VFS header/member offsets, and updating disc volume metadata/sector integrity; this path requires no fixed LBA255 code patch.
cached_toc_scope: VFS TOC is freshly read from current file LBA+1 at initialization; SDK directory cache is populated from disc, not an embedded original GR.VFS TOC.
limits: Static call-chain evidence, not gameplay validation or a proof about every unrelated executable constant. Rebuild must still verify ISO little/big-endian extents, volume size, sector EDC/ECC and a boot/runtime smoke test.
